issue.title: Owner-aware next-step offers after filing meeting notes
issue.description:
## Feature proposal

After a meeting is filed, offer Bryan the next steps he owns, i.e. the `(Owner) Action` rows in the normalized notes whose owner is Bryan, as candidate tasks. Each offer must be an explicit, preview-first choice and must never auto-create a task. Steps owned by other attendees stay in the recap and PDF only.

Source: the "Deferred" section of plan:202611/meeting_notes_event_refs.md (epic bob-cli-pw).
